text:
Mara - Growth Marketing: Quick sync — finalizing launch plan for the new RefApp Lite (OSS reference app + hands-on tutorial). Need: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar date, inbound lead routing, and social drafts. Who's on copy + assets?
Josh - DevRel: I can own the tutorial walkthrough + demo video. Do we want a short benchmark section comparing cold latency and cost for small dev workflows?
Samir - Content: yes include a lightweight benchmark. Suggest framing as ‘developer-first perf numbers’ not vendor debate. I have a baseline doc with 3 scenarios (local dev, hosted, quantized on dedicated) — will drop links.
Emily - Design: I'll mock hero + screenshots. Need final copy by EOD Wed to lock imagery. Any live UI screenshots we can use now?
Lee - GrowthOps: Webinar: propose Thurs May 12, 10am PT. Landing page will be gated (email + company). Routing: send registrants to /refapp-lite/thank-you with UTM and webhook to HubSpot. Also want to tag by 'use-case' for nurture flows.
Mara - Growth Marketing: @Josh please also write up 2 short benchmark blurbs: 1) cold-start latency (50–95th pct) and 2) per-request token cost with batching. Keep numbers simple for marketing.
Josh - DevRel: ok — rough numbers: cold-start 120ms median, 420ms p95 for small prompts on hosted v1; quantized dedicated reduces per-token cost ~3x in our tests. I'll format into one-sentence bullets.
Samir - Content: Draft social post for Twitter/X (feel free to tweak):
```
Launch: RefApp Lite — our lightweight OSS reference app for local+cloud devs. Learn how to deploy, optimize latency & cost, and run simple evals. Join the webinar May 12. https://redwood.ai/refapp-lite #oss #llm
```
Mara - Growth Marketing: Nice. Add a second tweet variant focused on benchmarking: "Benchmarks: same app, 3 config profiles — median latency, p95, and cost/1000 tokens. We surface config recipes so teams can optimize quickly"
Emily - Design: For hero, small checklist: 1) screenshot of setup flow, 2) benchmark chart (png), 3) short demo GIF. I can produce compressed assets for the blog.
Lee - GrowthOps: Routing details: HubSpot form -> zap -> webhook to /leads/refapp-lite. Tag fields: role, company size, interested-in (dev/test/prod). Can ops add auto-assignment rules?
Mara - Growth Marketing: @Lee yes, auto-assign leads >100 employees to AE queue, others to community nurture. Also add 'requested-demo' flag if they check box.
Samir - Content: Blog post outline (short bullets): 1) TL;DR + what it solves, 2) quickstart steps, 3) benchmark highlights with callouts, 4) tutorial links + webinar CTA, 5) how to contribute. I'll post first draft by Tue morning.
Josh - DevRel: For the benchmark section I'll attach command snippets and the condensate of the test harness:
```
# run local micro-bench
python bench.py --model small --seq 128 --quantize true --runs 100
```
Add a one-line note about variability and reproducible harness repo.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Marketing copy decisions: keep tone pragmatic and engineer-forward. Avoid product-y hyperbole. CTA ordering: 1) Try locally, 2) Watch webinar, 3) Star repo / contribute.
Emily - Design: Quick question — legal ok with the hashed numbers? or do we need "typical results" qualifier?
Samir - Content: We'll prefix the benchmark section with "Test setup and measured results; your mileage may vary" and link to the repo tests for reproducibility. That should satisfy compliance.
Lee - GrowthOps: Webinar ops: set up RSVP flow, confirm Zoom + recording auto-upload to CDN, add calendar invite to /events. I'll send calendar invites once registrants >50.
release-bot: New artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/refapp-lite/v1.0.0/refapp-lite-dist.tar.gz
Mara - Growth Marketing: Nice. Owners: Josh (tutorial + benchmark blurbs), Samir (blog + social drafts), Emily (assets), Lee (webinar + routing). Target publish: May 12 morning post + webinar same day.
Josh - DevRel: I'll PR the demo + bench snippets into the refapp repo by Mon EOD.
Samir - Content: Will iterate social copy after seeing final benchmarks. Two CTA variants: one for devs (hands-on), one for platform teams (deploy + cost).
Emily - Design: I'll post initial hero mocks in #design-review for quick feedback.
Mara - Growth Marketing: Ping if blocked. If legal wants review, @Samir will route. Accepting final copy Thurs morning. :thumbsup:
Lee - GrowthOps: I'll add lead routing playbook to the repo: /marketing/playbooks/refapp-lite-routing.md
Mara - Growth Marketing: Great — closing thread. Small follow-up: can someone add 1–2 customer scenarios to the blog (edge dev, internal platform)? @Josh can you add a quick demo script for that?
Josh - DevRel: yep will add two short scenario scripts in PR.
Samir - Content: copying the deadlines: draft blog Tue -> marketing review Wed -> assets locked Thu EOD -> publish Fri morning (May 12).
Mara - Growth Marketing: thanks team. Closing — will post consolidated checklist in channel tomorrow.
